details.availability: Public source; prebuilt worker images on Docker Hub per the recorder README

name: Cybergod
notes: Adjacent: a heterogeneous research repository. Besides the tmux environment (tmux_trials/lib.py) and the GUI/terminal recorder, it holds many exploratory experiments (action encoders, HID and physical input control, VM recording) and AGI manifesto text. Linked datasets on Hugging Face, ModelScope and Kaggle and the separate Vimgolf-Gym, CTF-Gym and Cybergod-Gym repositories are separate resources. The Cybergod paper is a self-published PDF release asset. No license file was found, so code rights stay unknown.
summary: Experimental monorepo for computer-control agents with a tmux terminal environment, a web recorder for GUI and terminal sessions in noVNC/ttyd Docker workers, and random-input data collection.
